about.title: About
body: I've been a full-stack developer since 2022. I work on systems companies use every day: business software, mobile apps, integrations with ERPs and partner APIs, PDF and Excel reports and automations, and I keep all of it running in production.

I've moved across many stacks and frameworks as each project needed. What stays constant is care for stability and for whoever supports the system next. I'm currently studying Computer Science at Faculdade de Americana.

jobs.body: I build and maintain web systems for clients across several industries: integrations with partner APIs such as Omie, TecnoSpeed, Vuupt and D4Sign, PDF and Excel report automation, RPA robots, and support for systems in production.

cv.summary: Full-stack developer since 2022. I build complete web systems for companies: React interfaces, Node.js and Python APIs, PostgreSQL, ERP integrations, mobile apps and automations. Computer Science student.
bullets: Build and maintain web systems for clients across industries with TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, PHP and React Native.
Business systems for HR, finance, billing, workshops, technical support, logistics and transport, from the database to the interface.
A mobile app for barcode-based order picking and checking, with its rules covered by automated tests.
Integrations with ERPs and partner APIs such as Omie, TecnoSpeed, Vuupt and D4Sign, plus PDF and Excel report automation.
Python RPA robots and a platform to schedule and follow them on Windows workstations.
